description: BOSTON (Oct. 30, 2024) - State Representative Steven Ultrino was named Legislator of the Year by the Providers’ Council during the 49th Annual Convention and Expo. Representative Ultrino was nominated for this award by Josh Young of Action for Boston Community Development (ABCD). Representative Ultrino was recognized for his commitment and support for the human services sector. The Providers’ Council is Massachusetts’ Largest Human Service Membership Association.
